xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AdditionalInformationOfLoansOr: United Breweries (Holding) Limited (UBHL) Amount INR 1,238 crores. Economic interest of the Company Yes Fully provided for Yes Note: As disclosed, the Company(USL) had pre-existing loans/ deposits/ advances/ accrued interest that were due to the USL and its subsidiaries from UBHL and its subsidiaries aggregating to INR 1,337 crores and that were consolidated into, and recorded as, an unsecured loan through an agreement entered into between the USL and UBHL on July 3, 2013 (Loan Agreement). UBHL defaulted on its obligations to pay any amounts under the Loan Agreement. The USL has made provision in prior financial years for the entire principal amount due of INR 1,337 crores, and for the accrued interest of INR 85 crores up to March 31, 2014. The USL has not recognized interest income on said loan after March 31,2014 which cumulatively amounts to INR 1343 crores up to March 31, 2025. The USL has offset INR 206 crores payable to UBHL arising under a trademark agreement against the principal amount of loan and interest accrued thereon.In 2018, USLs claim under arbitration against UBHL was rejected by the Arbitral Tribunal as being premature based on erroneous interpretation of the Loan Agreement. USL challenged the Award of the Tribunal under S.34 of the Arbitration Act before the Commercial Court. By its judgment of 03rd March 2025, the Commercial Court dismissed USLs challenge to the Award. USL has filed an appeal against the Judgment before the Karnataka High Court. USL has also filed its claim before the Official Liquidator of UBHL in 2020.
